abilities.name: Commander
abilities.text: Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

abilities.name: Freedom Fighters
abilities.text: The Supply Value of all Friendly Units Within 8″ of this Unit cannot be reduced below 1 for Contesting Mission Markers and completing objectives.

abilities.name: Orders
abilities.text: Select another Friendly Biological Unit Within 8″, spend CP and apply one of: 1 CP: that Unit's first used weapon gains CRITICAL HIT (2). 1 CP: that Unit ignores the Disengage penalty for the remainder of the Round. 2 CP: remove the Activation Marker from that Unit.
